<title
    level="1"
    right="Feat 12"
    pfs="Limited"
>
[Crimson Breath](/Feats.aspx?ID=4366) <actions string="Two Actions" />
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Archetype" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=12" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #194: Cult of the Cave Worm](/Sources.aspx?ID=209) pg. 81

**Archetype** [Worm Caller](/Archetypes.aspx?ID=208)

**Frequency**
once per day

**Prerequisites**
[Worm Caller Dedication](/Feats.aspx?ID=4357)

</column>

---

You gain a fire breath weapon similar to that of a [crimson worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=75). You breathe a blast of flame in a 30-foot cone that deals 12d6 fire damage to all creatures in the area ([basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). This damage increases by 2d6 at 14th level and every 2 levels thereafter.
